display_name: Tripwise_ Offer Performance and Driver Conversion

queryLines:
select driver_name, current_driving_score, tp.device_id, tp.trip_id, offers_shown,offers_clicked, did_convert, fo.offer_id,
leaving_home_zone_count,rough_road_conditions_count,high_risk_area_pct,sharp_turn_count, inclement_weather_pct, trip_date
from serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.trips tp
--join main.amee.policies pol on 
--tp.device_id = pol.device_id
join serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.dim_drivers drv
on tp.device_id = drv.device_id
left join serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.fact_offers fo
on tp.trip_id = fo.trip_id
and tp.device_id = fo.device_id

columns.description: Conversion rate as percentage (100 if converted, 0 otherwise)

datasets.name: 76a48e20
queryLines:
with amt as (
  select 
    case when premium_period = 'annual' then premium_amount end as original_premium_amt,
    case when premium_period = 'trip' then premium_amount end as trip_premium_amt,
    year(effective_date) as effective_year
  from serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.policies
  where year(effective_date) in ('2026','2025')
  and month(effective_date) <= 3
)
select 
  effective_year,
  (sum(trip_premium_amt)/sum(original_premium_amt))*100 as trip_premium_ratio
from amt
group by effective_year

columns.description: Binary active indicator for retention rate calculation
columns.expression: CASE WHEN is_active = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

columns.description: Daily premium yield for underwriter pricing analysis
columns.expression: CASE WHEN policy_duration_days > 0 THEN premium_amount / policy_duration_days ELSE 0 END

datasets.name: da66491c
queryLines:
SELECT
    drv.driver_name,
    tp.device_id,
    tp.trip_date,
    -- Offer metrics
    COUNT(*) AS offers_shown,
    SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_clicked,
    SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_converted,
    
    -- Calculated rates
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 
        2
    ) AS click_rate,
    
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 
        2
    ) AS conversion_rate,
    
    -- Driver context
    ROUND(AVG(driver_score_at_offer), 2) AS avg_driver_score,
    
    -- Revenue metrics
    SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN premium_monthly ELSE 0 END) AS total_premium_converted
    
FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.trips tp
join serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.dim_drivers drv
on tp.device_id = drv.device_id
left join serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.fact_offers fo
on tp.trip_id = fo.trip_id
and tp.device_id = fo.device_id
group by drv.driver_name,
    tp.device_id,
    tp.trip_date

datasets.name: 8c0d131d
queryLines:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN current_driving_score >= 90 THEN '90-100 (Excellent)'
    WHEN current_driving_score >= 80 THEN '80-89 (Good)'
    WHEN current_driving_score >= 70 THEN '70-79 (Average)'
    WHEN current_driving_score >= 60 THEN '60-69 (Fair)'
    ELSE 'Below 60 (Poor)'
  END as score_range,
  risk_tier,
  COUNT(*) as driver_count
FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.dim_drivers
WHERE risk_tier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY score_range, risk_tier
ORDER BY score_range DESC, risk_tier

datasets.name: d791e8fa
queryLines:
SELECT 
  min(driver_name) as driver_name,
  min(current_driving_score) as current_driving_score,
  min(total_miles) as total_miles,
  min(total_trips) as total_trips,
  min(risk_tier) as risk_tier,
  (sum(leaving_home_zone_count)+  sum(rapid_accel_count)+ sum(sharp_turn_count)+ sum(rough_road_conditions_count)) as total_incidents 
FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.dim_drivers d
join   serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.trips t
on d.device_id = t.device_id
group by d.device_id

datasets.name: 76afac42
queryLines:
SELECT 
  SUM(total_premium_converted) as total_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN report_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) THEN total_premium_converted ELSE 0 END) as recent_revenue,
  SUM(total_premium_converted) / NULLIF(SUM(offers_converted), 0) as avg_premium_per_conversion,
  SUM(offers_converted) as total_conversions
FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.agg_offer_performance

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_offers_shown,
  SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_offers_clicked,
  SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_conversions,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) as click_through_rate,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) as overall_conversion_rate,
  (SELECT AVG(days_to_convert) FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.agg_driver_conversions) as avg_days_to_convert
FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.fact_offers

datasets.name: 32562d9c
queryLines:
SELECT 
  'Offers Shown' AS stage, total_offers_shown AS cnt, 1 AS stage_order
FROM (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_offers_shown,
    SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_offers_clicked,
    SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_conversions,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS click_through_rate,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS overall_conversion_rate,
    (SELECT AVG(days_to_convert) FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.agg_driver_conversions) AS avg_days_to_convert
  FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.fact_offers
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Offers Clicked' AS stage, total_offers_clicked AS cnt, 2 AS stage_order
FROM (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_offers_shown,
    SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_offers_clicked,
    SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_conversions,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS click_through_rate,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS overall_conversion_rate,
    (SELECT AVG(days_to_convert) FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.agg_driver_conversions) AS avg_days_to_convert
  FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.fact_offers
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Conversions' AS stage, total_conversions AS cnt, 3 AS stage_order
FROM (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_offers_shown,
    SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_offers_clicked,
    SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_conversions,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN was_clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS click_through_rate,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN did_sign_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS overall_conversion_rate,
    (SELECT AVG(days_to_convert) FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.agg_driver_conversions) AS avg_days_to_convert
  FROM serverless_stable_mv5gxq_catalog.insurance_trip_wise.fact_offers

columns.description: Categorizes trip scores into underwriting risk bands
columns.expression: CASE WHEN trip_score >= 80 THEN 'Excellent (80-100)' WHEN trip_score >= 60 THEN 'Good (60-79)' WHEN trip_score >= 40 THEN 'Fair (40-59)' ELSE 'Poor (0-39)' END

columns.description: Sum of all risk events per trip
columns.expression: leaving_home_zone_count + rapid_accel_count + sharp_turn_count + rough_road_conditions_count

columns.description: Risk severity classification per trip based on total events
columns.expression: CASE WHEN (leaving_home_zone_count + rapid_accel_count + sharp_turn_count + rough_road_conditions_count) = 0 THEN 'Clean Trip' WHEN (leaving_home_zone_count + rapid_accel_count + sharp_turn_count + rough_road_conditions_count) <= 3 THEN 'Low Risk' WHEN (leaving_home_zone_count + rapid_accel_count + sharp_turn_count + rough_road_conditions_count) <= 8 THEN 'Moderate Risk' ELSE 'High Risk' END

columns.description: 100 if converted, 0 otherwise - use AVG for conversion rate %
columns.expression: CASE WHEN did_convert = TRUE THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END

columns.description: Flags trips with significant night driving exposure
columns.expression: CASE WHEN night_driving_pct >= 30 THEN 'Night Driver (30%+)' ELSE 'Day Driver (<30%)' END

columns.description: Max-to-avg speed ratio; higher = more erratic driving
columns.expression: CASE WHEN avg_speed_mph > 0 THEN max_speed_mph / avg_speed_mph ELSE 0 END

columns.description: Pct of shown offers that were clicked
columns.expression: CASE WHEN offers_shown > 0 THEN (offers_clicked * 100.0) / offers_shown ELSE 0 END

columns.description: Combined environmental risk exposure (night + area + weather)
columns.expression: night_driving_pct + high_risk_area_pct + inclement_weather_pct

columns.description: Categorizes trip distance for analysis
columns.expression: CASE WHEN distance_miles < 5 THEN 'Short (<5 mi)' WHEN distance_miles < 15 THEN 'Medium (5-15 mi)' WHEN distance_miles < 30 THEN 'Long (15-30 mi)' ELSE 'Very Long (30+ mi)' END

columns.description: The most frequent risk event type per trip
columns.expression: CASE WHEN leaving_home_zone_count >= rapid_accel_count AND leaving_home_zone_count >= sharp_turn_count AND leaving_home_zone_count >= rough_road_conditions_count THEN 'Left Home Zone' WHEN rapid_accel_count >= leaving_home_zone_count AND rapid_accel_count >= sharp_turn_count AND rapid_accel_count >= rough_road_conditions_count THEN 'Rapid Acceleration' WHEN sharp_turn_count >= leaving_home_zone_count AND sharp_turn_count >= rapid_accel_count AND sharp_turn_count >= rough_road_conditions_count THEN 'Sharp Turns' ELSE 'Rough Road' END

columns.description: Quarter-level truncation of trip_date for trend analysis
columns.expression: DATE_TRUNC("QUARTER", `trip_date`)

columns.description: Abbreviated month name for seasonality analysis
columns.expression: DATE_FORMAT(trip_date, 'MMM')

columns.description: Year as string for categorical coloring
columns.expression: CAST(YEAR(trip_date) AS STRING)
